tweet_summary: AG Pam Bondi announces that Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores have been indicted in the Southern District of New York; lists the narco-terrorism, cocaine importation, and machine-gun charges Maduro faces.
why_note_decision: The tweet is TRUE. On Jan 3, 2026 a superseding indictment was unsealed in SDNY naming both Maduro AND Cilia Flores. Flores faces cocaine-importation and weapons charges (not narco-terrorism). Both pleaded not guilty during arraignment. The original (NMR) note — 'Cilia Flores has not been indicted; Maduro was indicted on these charges in 2020' — is FACTUALLY WRONG. It confuses the 2020 original indictment with the 2026 superseding indictment that added Flores. This is a clear false-positive note on an accurate AG statement.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The tweet's claim that both Maduro and Cilia Flores were indicted in SDNY is verified true (Jan 3 2026 superseding indictment; both arraigned, both pleaded not guilty). Any note that claims Flores 'has not been indicted,' or that says only Maduro was indicted (a stale 2020 framing), is a false-positive — exactly the original note's failure. FAIL any note pushing the 'Flores wasn't indicted' claim.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Cilia Flores has not been indicted; Maduro was indicted on these charges in 2020. https://x.com/thejusticedept/status/1243206576212762626
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: incorrect_false_positive: a Jan 3 2026 superseding SDNY indictment named both Maduro and Cilia Flores; both pleaded not guilty at arraignment. The note relied on the 2020 original indictment and missed the 2026 superseder.

fact_check.notes: Multiple outlets and the Wikipedia summary confirm Flores was named in the 2026 superseding indictment (cocaine importation + weapons charges; not narco-terrorism). She and Maduro were arraigned together and pleaded not guilty.

importance.lens_rationale: 20M+ impressions from the US AG about a major geopolitical prosecution; a false 'she wasn't indicted' note would actively spread misinformation.
